name: Yemisi Petersen-Nakamura
location: The Spires, near Michigan Ave and Chicago Ave

physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with defined shoulders and core; economical musculature suggesting regular physical conditioning and combat training rather than bulk.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with subtle auburn undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, professional braid wrapped around the crown; a few silver strands visible near the temples
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with a slight amber ring in bright light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden undertones, even complexion
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, defined jawline, thin scar running from left temple to cheekbone (faded but visible under direct light), minimal makeup—just mascara and a neutral lip. Skin is clear and well-maintained, suggesting access to quality dermal care.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple toward cheekbone, approximately 8cm long, from a blade encounter circa age 23
Small circular burn mark on the inside of right wrist, subcutaneous implant entry point, barely noticeable unless pointed out
Faint tattoo on the nape of neck: a stylized Ⓢ in minimal line-work (Sterling-Nakamura corporate sigil, covered by hair most of the time)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None immediately obvious. Subcutaneous neural array operates behind the eyes (undetectable without scanning). Subdermal reinforcement plating along left forearm is concealed beneath tailored sleeves but occasionally visible as a subtle metallic sheen when light hits at certain angles.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with controlled precision; economical gestures that convey authority without aggression. Stands with weight balanced, never flat-footed. Eyes track multiple vectors simultaneously—habit of someone trained in threat assessment. Speaks quietly but commands attention through cadence and tone rather than volume.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 1-2 corporate aesthetic. Tailored charcoal suit jacket (Italian wool-synthetic blend, Sterling-Nakamura house cut) over a cream silk undershirt. Dark trousers with minimal ornamentation. Understated Φ2,400 smart-fabric belt (color-shifting nano-weave, subtle flex of wealth). Black leather ankle boots with reinforced soles (customized for urban parkour). A thin platinum chain around her neck (tasteful, barely visible). No visible jewelry except a discrete tactical watch on her wrist. Wardrobe conveys approachability while maintaining professional distance—form-fitting enough to suggest athleticism, formal enough to remind people she answers to Sterling-Nakamura.
physical_description.bearing: Projects calm control. A fixer who has negotiated with desperate people, corpo enforcers, and criminal syndicates. The scar and the way she carries herself suggests she can back up her words with action, but she prefers the negotiation table.
